stem: A researcher is investigating the lengths, in kilometres, of the journeys to work of the employees at a certain firm. She takes a random sample of 10 employees.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State what is meant by ‘random’ in this context.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem:
The results of her sample are as follows.

$$1.5 \qquad 2.0 \qquad 3.6 \qquad 5.9 \qquad 4.8 \qquad 8.7 \qquad 3.5 \qquad 2.9 \qquad 4.1 \qquad 3.0$$
parts.text: Find unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: State what is meant by ‘population’ in this context.
